summary: Amkor's planned high-volume advanced packaging and test campus in north Peoria, Arizona, backed by a final CHIPS award of up to USD 407 million. The project began as a multi-phase USD 2 billion plan approved by the city in 2024, moved to a larger site in the Peoria Innovation Core in August 2025, and broke ground in October 2025 with the planned investment raised to USD 7 billion across two phases. Amkor reported construction underway in August 2026 and expects the first phase to open in 2028.

location.note: A 104-acre parcel in north Peoria, exchanged in August 2025 for the 56-acre parcel originally designated in the Five North at Vistancia development.
